title: Owner-authorized controlled Solana Dune REST aggregate time-series path
objective: Implement a Solana-only controlled Dune REST path for allowlisted saved aggregate queries, aggregate-only PostgreSQL persistence through the existing macro schema, and an idempotent Feishu test-chat delivery adapter. The path must reject query/schema/version drift, incomplete UTC report-day timing, unregistered query IDs, BSC/Robinhood activation, raw payload persistence, sentiment values, and market-signal language.
owner_authorization: Owner authorizes Solana-only Dune live execution, aggregate-only PostgreSQL storage, and test-only Feishu delivery. DUNE_API_KEY must be a newly rotated Read-scope runtime secret and may only be injected as an environment variable. The approved Feishu test chat is supplied at runtime as FEISHU_TEST_CHAT_ID. PostgreSQL is the selected aggregate/manifest target via DATABASE_URL. No BSC, Robinhood, production-delivery expansion, raw-payload retention, scheduling, or trading capability is authorized.
forbidden_actions: Do not read, print, write, commit, or include any credential, .env file, database connection string, browser state, token, cookie, or raw provider payload in a repository or run artifact.
Do not submit dynamic SQL, create/update Dune saved queries, or run a query outside the Solana S1-S4 fixed allowlist.
Do not activate BSC, Four.meme, or Robinhood; Robinhood remains Uniswap v2/v3/v4 partial_coverage and is excluded from this run.
Do not modify CA facts, holder cleaning, creator precedence, Dev behavior, wallet clusters, or wallet-quality rules.
Do not claim users, buyers, demand, smart money, liquidity retention, lifecycle decay, external-pool conversion, sentiment, a recommendation, or a trading signal from these aggregates.
Do not schedule a job, retain raw Dune responses, or expand from the test chat to production delivery.
